nodes.summary: Test the intervention. Predict the flow.
nodes.body: Patient-specific flow modelling and intervention design. Explore vessel geometry and compare predicted flow; independent simulations and measurements are needed to validate predictions.

nodes.title: bríx

nodes.title: biophysical inference
nodes.summary: Find the mechanism. Guide the experiment.
nodes.body: SPR, SAXS and nanoparticle models connect measurements to competing physical explanations. The Research Journal retains the evidence and open questions.

nodes.title: trajectoríes
nodes.body: A research direction for computing and optimising individual purification trajectories. LNP / mRNA nanoparticles are the first application; other particle systems may follow.

nodes.title: Research Journal
nodes.body: The master record of research, evidence and decisions. The SPR Research Series belongs within this journal.

nodes.title: SPR Research Series
nodes.body: A research series within the Research Journal, connecting sensorgrams, models and the next informative experiment.

nodes.title: Colémak
nodes.body: An interaction prototype and hardware concept. Explore text entry, navigation and control through key layout, reach and measured input performance.

nodes.body: A modular eyewear concept coupling personal fit, optics, materials and mechanism. Test fit, retention, repeatability and whole-object balance.
